intro: Начать and продолжить often go with imperfect to name the activity; закончить indicates that it was reached at the end of that activity.

bloques.titulo: Начать and продолжить often go with imperfect to name the activity; закончить indicates that it was reached at the end of that activity.
texto: Начать and продолжить often go with imperfect to name the activity; закончить indicates that it was reached at the end of that activity.
The appearance is selected in relation to the meaning of the main verb, not by a single rule of translation.

frases.ru: Он начал читать статью после обеда.
frases.es: Empezó a leer el artículo después de comer.
frases.en: He started reading the article after eating.

frases.ru: К вечеру она закончила писать отчёт.
frases.es: Para la tarde terminó de escribir el informe.
frases.en: By the afternoon he finished writing the report.

opciones.explicacion: After закончить the activity is named with imperfective: переводить.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.

opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.
